title: Save and load
description:
Write a pair of functions that store a list of text lines in a file and read it back:

- `bool saveLines(const std::filesystem::path& file, const std::vector<std::string>& lines)`: writes one line per entry; returns `false` if the file could not be opened.
- `std::vector<std::string> loadLines(const std::filesystem::path& file)`: reads every line; returns an empty vector if the file does not exist.

`std::ofstream` writes, `std::ifstream` reads, and both close the file by themselves when they go out of scope.
